Marcus / Redwood team,

Thanks for the call this morning. A couple points from our side that we need reflected in the Order Form before procurement can proceed:

- Defense control: BrightFarm cannot accept unilateral vendor control for third-party IP claims unless we have final approval rights over settlements exceeding $250k.
- Evidence custody: in the event of an asserted infringement, we need clear steps for on-demand access to logs and the model request/response bundle (retention window & retrieval SLA).
- Insurance offset: our legal team needs to confirm whether insurance offsets will be allowed against your indemnity cap; prefer limited offsetting for carrier-covered defense costs only.

Attached our standard redline (we used track changes) and a short evidence requirements checklist for SRE. We need a firm path to sign-off by next Friday to meet our Q3 procurement window.

Regards,

Internal draft — forwarding BrightFarm redline and asks. High level thoughts and proposed playbook:

1) Defense control: propose hybrid model — Redwood will lead defense with right to appoint counsel; BrightFarm has approval for any settlement > $300k and must be consulted on covenants that affect customer business (non-monetary terms). This splits the difference and keeps operator continuity.

2) Evidence custody & retrieval SLA: SRE can provide a forensics bundle (redacted as needed) within 48 hours for P1 notices, 5 business days for lower priority. We should propose a secure transfer mechanism (SFTP with short-lived creds or pre-signed GCS link).

3) Insurance offset: recommend limiting offsets to defense costs paid by Redwood's insurer only and not to reduce indemnity for damages.

Action items for legal/ops sprint (timeline = 4 business days):
- Kimberly: draft precise language for hybrid defense control and settlement threshold.
- Ben: confirm the evidence bundle fields and prototype the evidence_capture_template.xlsx for BrightFarm review.
- Laura: coordinate procurement ask list and finalize the DocuSign envelope contents (we may need an exec credit approval if we move the threshold).

I attached my annotated redline (RDLINE_v3_marcus_comments.docx) and a starter evidence template. I plan to consolidate and send a single counter to BrightFarm by EOD tomorrow if we have Kimberly's language.

Marcus Lin
VP, Legal Ops | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RDLINE_v3_marcus_comments.docx]

Marcus — quick primer and proposed language (summary):

- Defense control (proposed clause): "Redwood shall have the right to assume control of the defense of any third-party claim alleging infringement of intellectual property. Customer shall have the right to participate, at its expense, and shall not unreasonably withhold approval of any settlement that would (a) require Customer to admit liability, (b) impose ongoing obligations on Customer, or (c) require the assignment of rights of Customer. Redwood shall obtain Customer's consent for any settlement exceeding $300,000, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld."

- Evidence retrieval SLA: suggest inclusion of a 72-hour initial acknowledgement and a 5-business-day forensic bundle delivery for full request/response logs. Provide a carve for PII — share redacted items, and Redwood will provide a certified attestation of completeness.

- Insurance offset: counter-propose "insurance contribution" language that allows Redwood to credit amounts paid by its insurer against defense costs only, not against indemnity for damages.

Attachment: redline_summary.pdf with inline snippets. I did not include escrow/escrow triggers — if procurement insists on escrow, we need scope/threshold discussion.

Kimberly Park
Head of Contracts | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redline_summary.pdf]

Couple operational clarifications from Ops/Forensics POV (adding Tom's earlier security notes):

- Evidence bundle fields (we'll mirror the attached evidence_capture_template.xlsx): timestamped request/response pairs, request metadata (IP, API key hash), model and model-version, truncated prompt + full output hash, and a retrieval manifest. We can provide hashes for long training inputs instead of full texts where advisable.

- Transfer mechanism: we can stand up a time-limited GCS signed URL or SFTP account per incident. For customer convenience, 48 hours for P1 seems tight with legal/privilege review — recommend 72 hours for initial bundle, full bundle within 7 business days depending on scope.

- Audit trail: Redwood will include a certified manifest and chain-of-custody stamp in the bundle. If procurement needs evidence escrow, ops recommends a staged approach (1) internal certified bundle, (2) escrow deposit only for claims that proceed to litigation.

I'll validate the template and update the spreadsheet.

Ben Carter

Lucy — thanks for the clarity and for sharing BrightFarm's redline. We ran an internal sprint and below is our consolidated counter-proposal and next steps. High level summary first, then the proposed clause text snippets attached.

Summary (what we're offering):
- Hybrid defense control with a $300,000 approval threshold for Customer consent on settlements (Customer participation rights preserved).
- Evidence retrieval: 72-hour acknowledgement; initial forensic bundle within 72 hours for P1; full bundle within 7 business days. Secure transfer via pre-signed GCS link; certified manifest included.
- Insurance offsets limited to defense costs only (i.e., amounts paid by Redwood's insurer may reduce Redwood's defense costs but not the indemnity for damages paid to third parties).
- Escrow: Redwood will accept discussion of conditional escrow if BrightFarm provides projected claim thresholds and a narrow trigger definition; otherwise, staged approach recommended (internal certified bundle → escrow request if claim proceeds to litigation).

Attachments: consolidated redline (RDLINE_v3_marcus_comments.docx), redline_summary.pdf, evidence_capture_template.xlsx. We are ready to present this on a 30-minute call tomorrow (BrightFarm time) to finalize language. If that works, I'll send a DocuSign-ready bundle afterward.

Next steps (proposed):
- Lucy: confirm whether BrightFarm can accept $300k threshold or prefers $250k (we can escalate internally for exec approval if you need $250k).
- Tom (security): confirm retention window/PII redaction expectations against our proposed manifest.
- Procurement: indicate whether escrow is a hard requirement for Q3 sign-off.

If we get a thumbs-up on threshold and evidence window, we aim to have a mutually signed Order Form by 2028-07-12 to meet your procurement timelines.

Best,
Marcus Lin
VP, Legal Ops | Redwood Inference
